Dear Architect,
The Council of Architecture is pleased to announce exclusive insurance policies specifically designed for Architects in collaboration with ICICI Lombard General Insurance Co. Ltd (ICICI Lombard) and KM Dastur Reinsurance Brokers Pvt. Ltd. (KMD). The following insurance policies are proposed for the welfare of Architects registered with the Council of Architecture:
1. Health Insurance Policy for Architects and their Dependents
2. Personal Accident Insurance for Architects
3. Professional Indemnity Insurance for Architects
The above policies have been meticulously curated to ensure you a fully loaded insurance plan at very attractive premium being group policies. The insurance scheme for architects under the aegis of the Council of Architecture (CoA) holds paramount significance in ensuring the well-being and security of various stakeholders within the architectural community.
This comprehensive insurance initiative encompasses Architects registered with the Council, offering them a safety net in the face of unforeseen circumstances and underlines the Council’s commitment to providing valuable resources and financial security to our esteemed Architects and their families.
